title: CEO
conviction_themes: Expo will become the default way to build mobile apps — targeting 80-85% of all mobile apps built on Expo
React Native + Expo wins on iteration speed; native-first builds slow teams down

previous_experiences: Co-founded Expo (formerly Exponent) in 2015 to make mobile development universally accessible; grew to 3M+ developers.
Co-founded Quora with Adam D'Angelo in June 2009; stepped down from active management in September 2012.
At Facebook, oversaw the creation of Facebook Connect and the Facebook Platform as engineer and manager.
Software Development Engineer at Amazon prior to joining Facebook.
Built bunny1, an open-source smart bookmarks tool in Python (208 GitHub stars).
Co-founder and contributor to Castle (castle.xyz), a mobile app for creating and playing interactive scenes and games.
Graduated from Harvard College with an A.B. in Computer Science.
bio_text: Charlie Cheever is the co-founder and CEO of Expo, the open-source framework and cloud platform that powers React Native apps for 3M+ developers and has placed apps at #1 in the US App Store. Previously he co-founded Quora and was an early engineer/manager at Facebook where he built Facebook Connect and the Facebook Platform. He is deeply conviction-driven on Expo becoming the universal default for building mobile and web apps, especially as AI expands who can ship software.
